notes: Medium emulated-guest networking pipeline. The agent must (1) author a run_guest.sh that boots a headless qemu VM (serial console on a unix socket) AND drives its console non-interactively (typed root login + hostname + /etc/rc/enroll) to a configured/usable state, (2) configure qemu user-mode hostfwd so host 127.0.0.1:61234 reaches guest ssh 22 (and 127.0.0.1:18080 -> guest 3733), (3) prove UI reachability via ssh_host_exec.sh, and (4) repair real host name resolution (append 127.0.0.1 nysa.test to /etc/hosts) so a genuine fetch of http://nysa.test:18080/live returns the page the guest hosts live (RELAY-LIVE kestrel <per-boot salt>) and save it exactly to /app/fetch_result.html. Hidden cases force builds that generalize: fetch.py must fail cleanly (no file mutation) on a dead/unreachable URL, ssh_host_exec.sh must run an arbitrary remote command and return a nonzero usage on no argument, and run_guest.sh must be idempotent across repeated invocations (no duplicate qemu). The guest is a distro-less busybox+dropbear OS provisioned by the supplied mkguest.sh fixture, so difficulty concentrates on serial-console automation, host->guest port forwarding, and live-net repair/generalization rather than OS packaging; an agent missing any of the three gap competencies fails (no ssh reach, no transform log from the console drive, or a fetch_result.html that differs from a fresh live fetch). Bucket total 14 => medium.
